project.title: Microbial community in various designs of wastewater treatment facility bioreactors
project.description: Municipal wastewater treatment facilities rely on the application of numerous “activated sludge” process designs to achieve treatment goals that are specific to the composition of the wastewater, site-specific regulations, and other factors. Samples from 24 different wastewater treatment facilities (37 bioreactors) with various system designs were collected
